title: One-Word Jutsu Shortcuts
body:
Syntax: jutsu shorts | jutsu shortcuts

Every jutsu has a unique one-word shortcut. Type it directly, followed by a target or on/off when needed. Examples: dyn bandit, ras bandit, hmist on, smove off. You can also use per <shortcut>, such as per ras bandit. Without a target, offensive jutsu use your current opponent as usual.

Jutsu shorts lists shortcuts for techniques you have learned. Jutsu all shows shortcuts alongside your class catalog. Help <shortcut> opens that technique's normal help page. Existing full names and older shortcuts still work. Shortcuts do not bypass learning, practice, access rules, hand signs, costs or cooldowns.
